cagey_review_rule: >= 50 graded correction-only value picks with mean CLV < 0; recommends cagey_correction_enabled = false
cagey_tier_review_rule: >= 50 graded value-priced cagey-tier picks made under the active rule (no-loss-market-reference-120-200-v6) with realised ROI 95% interval entirely below 0; recommends cagey_tier_enabled = false

cagey tier.definition: CLV = frozen offered odds x Pinnacle fair close probability - 1 (clv_report). Return = flat-stake profit per unit at the frozen price. Per fixture: a match's picks averaged first, so each match counts once.

strong master (live).definition: CLV = frozen offered odds x Pinnacle fair close probability - 1 (clv_report). Return = flat-stake profit per unit at the frozen price. Per fixture: a match's picks averaged first, so each match counts once.

master_comparison.decided: 13 Nov 2026, before any live result of the new master
master_comparison.rule: After at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 calendar weeks (on each list), compare flat-stake return per bet at Pinnacle prices: new master minus live master, whole kickoff weeks resampled (the same weeks for both lists), 95% interval. Hit rate, average price, vetoed, ignored and missing-view counts are context only. The new master is better only if the interval is entirely above zero.

new_master_failed.status: NEW MASTER FAILED - OLD MASTER PUBLISHED

master_rollback.message: The old master is live (master_shortlist_config.json, live "old"); the rollback rule does not apply.
master_rollback.rule: After at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 calendar weeks on each list, compare flat-stake return per bet at Pinnacle prices, new master minus old master, whole kickoff weeks resampled (the same weeks for both), 95% interval. If the interval is entirely below zero, the weekly report says ROLLBACK TRIGGERED at the top and in the run summary. Nothing switches automatically: Paul decides, and rolling back is setting live to "old".

note: CLV = entry odds x Pinnacle near-kickoff fair win-share on the same AH line - 1 (power method, as clv_report). Near-kickoff feed quotes, not verified official closes or executed bets. Tagged candidates are tracked for the narrow-margin hypothesis only; they never change a decision.

recommendation_history.note: Every captured generation is graded at its own offered odds; re-uploads deduplicate. Repeated fixtures and overlapping lists are correlated recommendations, not independent bets. Unit returns are hypothetical, not actual betting ROI. Latest-view reports remain separate.

comparison.rule: Decided 23 Nov 2026, before any strong-master pick: after at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 calendar weeks on each list, flat-stake return per bet at Pinnacle prices, strong master minus live master, whole kickoff weeks resampled (the same weeks for both), 95% interval. The strong master is better only if the interval is entirely above zero. Results by market group, tier and research label are context only.

research_gate_review.review: Kept from R3, now covering all picks: once 50 strong-master picks under this rule are graded, the weekly report compares graded picks (research no-loss >= 0.70) with the offers left out only by this check (observed no-loss minus market no-loss, each), and Paul keeps or drops it.
research_gate_review.rule: Every pick in every tier (proven, not proven: safe, fill, risky fill): an offer is eligible only if the research view (live research v5 domestic, v6 UCL/UEL; the row's research_no_loss_probability for that exact bet, line and price) gives no-loss >= 0.70. An offer with no research view is not eligible. Ineligible offers are LEFT_OUT with the reason ('research no-loss below 0.70' or 'no research view'). R3 extended from UCL/UEL proven picks (Paul, 24 Nov 2026; plan Phase 4d, Part 2), a deliberate exception to the release gate: no backtest before release.

rollback.message: waiting for at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 weeks on each list
rollback.rule: After at least 150 graded matches over at least 3 calendar weeks on each list, compare flat-stake return per bet at Pinnacle prices, strong master minus today's master, whole kickoff weeks resampled (the same weeks for both), 95% interval. If the interval is entirely below zero, the weekly report says ROLLBACK TRIGGERED at the top. Nothing switches automatically: Paul decides, and rolling back is setting live to "new".

weak_link_review.review: Weekly review: graded results of flagged against unflagged picks, and per reason; once 50 flagged picks are graded, each reason can be kept or dropped (Paul decides).
